theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Japan 30-Year Bond Sale Sees Weaker Demand Than 12-Month Average
top_news.summary: Japan’s 30-year government bond auction drew weaker demand than its 12-month average as concerns over global fiscal policy weighed on investor appetite.

top_news.title: Copper Extends Rebound as Global Technology Stocks Resume Rally
top_news.summary: Copper extended its rebound from last week’s slump, tracking a rally in technology shares due to the metal’s use in power infrastructure and data centers.

top_news.title: Singapore Launches Gold Vaulting Service for Central Banks
top_news.summary: Singapore has launched a gold vaulting service for overseas central banks and official institutions, seeking to capitalize on global demand to diversify storage of bullion reserves.

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Ride Tech Rally Higher as Oil Drops: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks headed for their biggest two-day advance since early August, boosted by a tech rally and a further decline in oil prices.

top_news.title: Hegseth Hits Out at Critics as Massie Pushes Impeachment
top_news.summary: President Donald Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio defended Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth after Republican representative Thomas Massie introduced articles of impeachment over military operations in Iran. Hegseth has rejected calls to step down, characterizing the effort as politically motivated. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Kioxia Leveraged Product Debuts in HK After One Year Hiatus
top_news.summary: A leveraged product tracking Kioxia Holdings Corp. debuts in Hong Kong on Tuesday, the first such single-stock instrument in the city since a similar SK Hynix Inc. product helped trigger extreme volatility in the underlying stock and drew market scrutiny.

top_news.title: China Water Environment Seeks $410 Million Loan Restructuring
top_news.summary: China Water Environment Group, one of the nation’s largest sewage treatment firms, is seeking to restructure about $410 million of offshore loans, according to people familiar with the matter, adding to a growing number of Chinese state-backed firms facing debt challenges.

top_news.title: Berkshire Tests Wider Yen Spreads in Latest Japan Bond Deal
top_news.summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. is marketing its latest yen bond deal at wider levels than it offered in April, highlighting how investors are demanding more compensation to buy debt.

top_news.title: Indonesia Markets Second Panda Bond Offering Despite MSCI Threat
top_news.summary: Indonesia has begun marketing its second yuan-denominated bond in China’s domestic debt market, even as Southeast Asia’s largest economy grapples with the threat of a double downgrade from MSCI Inc.

top_news.title: China Sells Debut Green Bonds in Canada Amid Robust Demand
top_news.summary: China drew robust demand for its debut yuan-denominated green bond sale in Canada, expanding its offshore debt footprint to finance sustainable projects as ties between the two nations warm.
